Note::normalize_quotes¶

Back to Note API Reference

Signature¶

Note Note::normalize_quotes() const

Convert Curly Quotes To Straight ASCII Quotes¶

normalize_quotes() returns a new Note, same shape as the input, with typographic quotation marks replaced by their straight ASCII equivalents: the curly double quotes “ ” „ ‟ all become ", and the curly single quotes / apostrophes ‘ ’ ‚ ‛ all become '. Use it to normalise text pasted from word processors, PDFs, or the web before matching, tokenizing, or feeding a parser that expects ASCII quotes.

Only quote characters are affected; everything else in the cell is unchanged. normalize_quotes is shape-preserving, cell-independent, and returns a fresh Note.

Example 1: A Batch¶

const auto n = pluss::make_note(
    {std::string("\xE2\x80\x9C") + "hi" + "\xE2\x80\x9D" + " it" + "\xE2\x80\x99" + "s",
     "plain"}).normalize_quotes();
std::cout << n << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[2], dim=1, numel=2, encoding=utf8)
["\"hi\" it's", "plain"]

The curly “ ” become " and the curly ’ becomes '; print shows the straight double quotes escaped as \" inside its own quoting.
